We interviewed 24 new accounts in September about their first week.

What we heard:

✅ 17 of 24 asked for a guided setup that connects their first data source.

✅ Most gave up on the blank workspace within ten minutes.

  • Setup should take under five minutes.
  • Sample data helps people see the value before they connect anything.

Decision

We will build guided setup this quarter and measure activation within 7 days.
